items.titleEn: In the Sudan... A chemical imprint that tells the story of 10,000 years of travel.
items.summaryEn: The migration of humans and cows in Sudan has been linked to environmental and societal changes over the past 10,000 years, and scientists have come to these conclusions through chemical analysis of the dental enamel of 33 sites between the 3rd and 4th Nile Falls.
